column1:
Through the Intel® She Will Connect program, reduce the Internet gender gap by 
50% in Sub-Saharan Africa by 2016.
column2:
In 2014, we began to develop key foundational elements of the program 
including the partner ecosystem and digital literacy training activities, and began 
work on a new online learning platform. Based on learnings and stakeholder 
input during the first year of the program, we decided to redesign certain 
program components to drive greater social impact and to extend the timeline 
for reaching our goal to 2020.

column1:
Provide ICT training to 1 million healthcare workers in developing countries by 
the end of 2015 through the Intel World Ahead 1Mx15 Health Program.
column2:
We achieved our goal in 2014, reaching 1 million healthcare workers in China, 
Ghana, Kenya, Nigeria, Sri Lanka, and Tanzania.
